definitions.explanation: A performance of rhythmic movement, often traditional Japanese dance.

examples.japanese: {盆|ぼん}{踊|おど}りに{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: I participated in the Bon dance.

examples.japanese: {踊|おど}りを{習|なら}っています。
{日本|にほん}{舞踊|ぶよう}の{踊|おど}り

notes:
{踊|おど}り is a noun meaning 'dance,' derived from the verb {踊|おど}る.

Types of dance in Japanese:
- {踊|おど}り: general dance, often traditional
- ダンス: Western-style dance
- {舞踊|ぶよう}: formal/artistic dance
- {舞|まい}: classical/elegant dance (more literary)

Common compounds:
- {盆|ぼん}{踊|おど}り: Bon dance (summer festival dance)
- {民謡|みんよう}{踊|おど}り: folk dance
- {踊|おど}り{子|こ}: dancer (traditional)
